title: Strict tower of finite-coefficient total tensor complexes
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$ and specified uniformizer $t$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and any scheme $W$. Let $B_W=\widehat R_W$ with its projections to $A_{W,n}=(R/t^{n+1})_W$ on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. For arbitrary unbounded cochain complexes $P,Q$ of $B_W$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], let $P_n=P\otimes_{B_W}A_{W,n}$ and $Q_n=Q\otimes_{B_W}A_{W,n}$ with their termwise quotient maps [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. Define $T_n(P,Q)$ to be the scalar restriction along $B_W\to A_{W,n}$ of the direct-sum total tensor of $P_n,Q_n$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], using sheafified balanced module tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Its degree-$d$ term is $\bigoplus_{i+j=d}P_n^i\otimes_{A_{W,n}}Q_n^j$ and its differential on this summand is $d_P\otimes1+(-1)^i1\otimes d_Q$. Use the existing restriction-of-scalars functor [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Define the tensor section and total tensor section to be respectively the sheafification image of $x\otimes y$ and its $(i,j)$ direct-sum inclusion. The transition $T_{n+1}(P,Q)\to T_n(P,Q)$ is the unique natural chain map sending each such generator $x\otimes y$ to the tensor of the two quotient images. Define the strict tensor-tower functor on both input chain maps by applying finite reduction, total tensor and scalar restriction levelwise, retaining these transitions. This is a functor from pairs of complexes to strict inverse sequences of complexes of $B_W$-modules. Neither flatness nor K-flatness nor any boundedness, completeness, constructibility or coefficient-invertibility hypothesis is imposed on $P,Q,W$. Scheme and coefficient universes are independent.
